bootstrap_go_toolset: run the bootstrap function to install a hermetic Go toolset in the default location
prepare_go_environ: create a dictionary of environment variables needed to use the installed Go toolset
install_go_toolset: build and install a specific Go toolset version by downloading and extracting the archive
check_hello_world: test the Go toolset by compiling and running a hello world program to verify it works
find_go_executable: run a search to find the full path to a Go executable in GOROOT or GOBIN directories
